QuestInfo.name: Blind and Battered 2
QuestInfo.0: Your first battle in this world went off without a hitch. And Kanetsugu is back!
QuestInfo.1: Kanetsugu was quite successful. You need to step it up and completely block the enemy's scouting activities. Defeat 30 more Oda Scouts.
QuestInfo.2: You feel like you can do better when it comes to stopping the scouts. It has nothing to do with Kanetsugu's work. It wasn't even that impressive, really.
